user.title: Connect to Mujin Music
user.description: Enter the address of the computer or server running Mujin Music. Servers on your network are usually found automatically.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of your Mujin Music server.
data_description.port: Mujin Music listens on 1993 unless you changed it.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Mujin Music found
zeroconf_confirm.description: Add the {brand} library **{name}** at {host}? Every zone (apps, Sonos rooms, AirPlay and UPnP speakers, audio devices and linked groups) becomes a media player.

auth.title: Sign in to Mujin Music
auth.description: Pairing is recommended: Home Assistant gets its own device session that you can revoke from the app, and no password is stored.

menu_options.login: Sign in with username and password

pair.title: Approve Home Assistant

login.title: Sign in to {name}
login.description: Your password is used once to create a device session and is not stored.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The saved session for **{name}** expired or was revoked. Pair again or sign in to keep your media players working.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Mujin Music at that address.
error.too_many_attempts: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
error.pairing_pending: Not approved yet. Enter the code in the Mujin Music app, then select Submit again.
error.pairing_expired: That code expired. A new code is shown below.

abort.already_configured: This Mujin Music library is already set up.
abort.not_mujin_music: This device is not a Mujin Music server.
abort.ipv6_not_supported: Found over IPv6 only; add the server by its IPv4 address instead.
abort.pairing_unavailable: The server is not accepting pairing requests right now. Try again shortly.
abort.wrong_server: That address belongs to a different Mujin Music library.

zone_unavailable.message: This zone is not available right now.

not_a_zone.message: {entity_id} is not a Mujin Music zone on this server.

unknown_source.message: There is no zone called {source} to play from.

media_source_unsupported.message: Mujin Music plays from its own library. Pick an item from the Mujin Music media browser instead.

no_servers.message: No Mujin Music server is set up.

media_not_found.message: Nothing in the Mujin Music library matches "{query}".

item_not_found.message: {item} is no longer in the Mujin Music library.

standby_unsupported.message: This zone cannot be switched off; pause it instead.

nothing_matches.message: Nothing in the Mujin Music library matches that request.

start_radio.name: Start radio
start_radio.description: Starts an endless station in this zone, seeded by an album, artist, song, genre or playlist (library radio when nothing is given).

item.name: Item
item.description: Media browser id to seed from, e.g. album:…, artist:…, song:…, genre:Jazz or radio:library.

query.name: Search
query.description: Seed from the best match for this text instead, e.g. "Miles Davis".

kind.name: Search for
kind.description: Limit the search to one kind of item.

thumbs_up.name: Thumbs up
thumbs_up.description: Likes the playing track: radio plays more like it.

thumbs_down.name: Thumbs down
thumbs_down.description: Dislikes the playing track: it is skipped now and radio stays away from it.

transfer.name: Transfer playback
transfer.description: Moves this zone's queue, track and position to another zone.

destination.name: Destination
destination.description: The Mujin Music zone that takes over.

sleep_timer.name: Sleep timer
sleep_timer.description: Fades out and pauses this zone after a number of minutes (0 cancels the timer).

pause_all.name: Pause all zones
pause_all.description: Pauses every zone that is playing.

config_entry_id.name: Server
config_entry_id.description: Only this Mujin Music server (all servers when empty).
